datasets.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive: Planetary Systems Composite Parameters (PSCompPars), all confirmed planets, with default-parameter-set provenance from the Planetary Systems (PS) table
datasets.organization: NASA Exoplanet Archive, operated by Caltech/IPAC (NExScI) for the NASA Exoplanet Exploration Program
datasets.purpose: Exoplanet layer, planet/system info panels and habitability-lab inputs: one row per confirmed planet with orbit, radius, mass, density, insolation, equilibrium temperature, host-star parameters, discovery data, uncertainties, limit flags and per-parameter literature references.
datasets.mechanism: IVOA TAP sync, ADQL -> JSON (format=json); raw responses cached gzip-compressed in data-raw/exoplanets; normalised to compact {fields, rows} JSON
datasets.query: select pl_name,pl_letter,hostname,sy_snum,sy_pnum,sy_mnum,cb_flag,pl_controv_flag,discoverymethod,disc_year,disc_facility,disc_refname,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbperlim,pl_orbper_reflink,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,pl_orbsmaxlim,pl_orbsmax_reflink,pl_orbeccen,pl_orbeccenerr1,pl_orbeccenerr2,pl_orbeccenlim,pl_orbeccen_reflink,pl_orbincl,pl_orbinclerr1,pl_orbinclerr2,pl_orbincllim,pl_orbincl_reflink,pl_orblper,pl_orblpererr1,pl_orblpererr2,pl_orblperlim,pl_orblper_reflink,pl_tranmid,pl_tranmiderr1,pl_tranmiderr2,pl_tranmidlim,pl_tranmid_reflink,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_rade_reflink,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_bmasselim,pl_bmasse_reflink,pl_dens,pl_denserr1,pl_denserr2,pl_denslim,pl_dens_reflink,pl_insol,pl_insolerr1,pl_insolerr2,pl_insollim,pl_insol_reflink,pl_eqt,pl_eqterr1,pl_eqterr2,pl_eqtlim,pl_eqt_reflink,st_teff,st_tefferr1,st_tefferr2,st_tefflim,st_teff_reflink,st_rad,st_raderr1,st_raderr2,st_radlim,st_rad_reflink,st_mass,st_masserr1,st_masserr2,st_masslim,st_mass_reflink,st_lum,st_lumerr1,st_lumerr2,st_lumlim,st_lum_reflink,st_met,st_meterr1,st_meterr2,st_metlim,st_met_reflink,st_age,st_ageerr1,st_ageerr2,st_agelim,st_age_reflink,st_logg,st_loggerr1,st_loggerr2,st_logglim,st_logg_reflink,sy_dist,sy_disterr1,sy_disterr2,sy_dist_reflink,sy_plx,sy_plxerr1,sy_plxerr2,sy_plx_reflink,sy_vmag,sy_vmagerr1,sy_vmagerr2,sy_vmag_reflink,sy_kmag,sy_kmagerr1,sy_kmagerr2,sy_kmag_reflink,sy_gaiamag,sy_gaiamagerr1,sy_gaiamagerr2,sy_gaiamag_reflink,pl_tranmid_systemref,pl_bmassprov,st_spectype,st_spectype_reflink,st_metratio,ra,dec,ra_reflink,sy_pmra,sy_pmraerr1,sy_pmraerr2,sy_pmdec,sy_pmdecerr1,sy_pmdecerr2,sy_pm,sy_pm_reflink,hd_name,hip_name,tic_id,gaia_dr3_id,pl_radj,pl_bmassj from pscomppars ;; select pl_name,hostname,default_flag,soltype,pl_refname,st_refname,sy_refname,pl_pubdate,releasedate,rowupdate from ps where default_flag=1 ;; select count(*) as n from ps where default_flag=1
datasets.version: live archive state at retrieval (latest PS default-row release date 2026-10-15; 6451 confirmed planets = count(*) from ps where default_flag=1)

datasets.updateCadence: Archive is updated weekly (Thursday news/update cycle); this snapshot is refreshed on demand with `node scripts/data/exoplanets/run.mjs --refresh`
datasets.cachePolicy: versioned offline snapshot; optional online refresh
datasets.fallback: If planets.json is missing or invalid: hide the exoplanet layer and catalogue presets of the habitability lab and show "exoplanet catalogue unavailable"; the lab may still run on user-entered parameters labelled illustrative. Never substitute invented values.
datasets.limitations: Composite table: a planet's parameters may come from different references and need not be self-consistent (use the PS table for a single consistent solution). pl_eqt assumptions (Bond albedo, heat redistribution) differ by reference: 1090 values were calculated by the archive (zero albedo, full redistribution, no uncertainties), others come from papers or catalogues such as the Kepler DR25 KOI table. 3035 masses (pl_bmassprov = 'M-R relationship') are archive estimates from the Chen & Kipping (2017) mass-radius relation, not measurements; pl_bmasse may be a minimum mass (Msini). Archive-calculated values carry no uncertainties. Positions are ICRS at the source epoch (J2015.5 for TIC v8), not propagated. pl_tranmid time standards vary (see pl_tranmid_systemref). Limit-flag semantics (1 = upper limit, -1 = lower limit) were verified empirically (archive docs do not state them); one row carries an undocumented pl_denslim value of 9.

datasets.name: Exoplanet host systems (one record per host star) derived from the PSCompPars snapshot
datasets.organization: Derived by the Cosmos/AstroNexus project from NASA Exoplanet Archive data (Caltech/IPAC)
datasets.purpose: Place exoplanet host stars in the 3D star field (ICRS Cartesian parsecs), host-level stellar parameters for system views and the habitability lab, and the index of each host's planets in planets.json.
datasets.mechanism: Offline aggregation of the PSCompPars snapshot by hostname + spherical-to-Cartesian conversion (x = d cos(dec) cos(ra), y = d cos(dec) sin(ra), z = d sin(dec))
datasets.version: derived from the PSCompPars snapshot retrieved 2026-10-16T18:28:50.774Z

datasets.fallback: If systems.json is missing: hosts can be rebuilt client-side by grouping planets.json rows on hostname and converting ra/dec/sy_dist; if both files are missing hide the exoplanet layer.
datasets.limitations: xPc/yPc/zPc are derived (not observed) and inherit the archive distance uncertainties; 28 hosts have no distance (null coordinates). Host stellar values follow a documented selection rule because composite rows of the same host can disagree (222 hosts; listed per host in stVarying). Positions are at the source epoch (posEpochJyr), not propagated. Distances for microlensing hosts are model-dependent with large uncertainties.
